subtitle: Four directions for the redrawn architecture map in the Footnote launcher, all on this repository's real graph (8 blocks, 12 links, outside packages, memories anchored to code). Pick a base, tune it, write notes, lock it.

preview.headline: How BorgKnowledge is built
preview.lede: Blocks from the compiler graph, links counted in references, outside packages by kind, and the memories your agents anchored to each block.
preview.caption: compiler graph · rust-analyzer · 1,052 symbols
features: Boxes inside the system box, labelled links, open a block to go one level down.
Each block shows what your agents remembered about it, from anchored memories.
Databases, network and model packages each block depends on.

directions.name: Blueprint (your mix)
directions.line: D2 living canvas and Flows panel, D3 memory pills and soft tiles on a blueprint grid; the code in its own zone, calls in on the left, calls out on the right by kind: databases, model runtimes, network APIs, files and system. D4 Strata becomes the Layers tab.

directions.name: Living canvas
directions.line: IcePanel-like: dense small cards in group frames, every link says what it does, a Flows panel lights a path.

directions.name: Flow and memory
directions.line: Footnote's own: references flow as dots, memories pinned to blocks, an inspector with the block's memories, links and docs. Keeps the locked launcher brand.

directions.name: Strata
directions.line: No graph: layers from entry to base to outside, links as weighted lines between strata, editorial serif.
